Sentence (English): Stay away from lg dishwashers like plague.
Comments (English): [ Poor installation by unqualified "technicians" Stay Away!  ] || ---------------- || Stay away from lg dishwashers like plague. The installation of this LG dishwasher was an absolute debacle, a testament to incompetence that left me utterly aghast. From the moment the so-called "installer" darkened my doorstep, a sense of impending doom permeated the air. Their fumbling attempts to maneuver the appliance into place resembled a slapstick routine rather than a professional service. Scratches now mar my pristine kitchen floor, a permanent testament to their clumsy handling. The connections were a nightmare. Hoses were kinked, fittings were loose, and I shudder to think what long-term damage lurks. Water pressure is now erratic, a direct consequence of their inability to properly integrate the dishwasher into my existing plumbing. It's as if they approached the task blindfolded, armed with nothing but sheer ignorance. Forget any semblance of leveling; the dishwasher rocks precariously with the slightest touch, a constant source of anxiety. The control panel looks askew, a glaring imperfection that screams of carelessness. It's an insult to the sleek design of the appliance itself, marred by this shoddy execution. This wasn't an installation; it was an assault on my time, my patience, and my property. The individual responsible should be barred from ever touching another appliance. To call their work unprofessional is a gross understatement. It was a masterclass in how not to install a dishwasher, a truly dreadful experience that I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy. LG, you owe your customers far better than this appalling display of ineptitude.

Comments (English): [ Feels Cheap But Cleans Well ] || ---------------- || Bought this to replace a Kitchenaid that was 3 years old. yeah. Had it delivered and installed it myself. Installation was easy, everything on the old unit swapped to the new one so I didn't have to use an installation kit. This unit had no insulation on it except for some sound deadening material on the outside walls and top. I swapped over the insulation blanket and bottom surround pieces. The door feels light and cheap and I was immediately concerned at what the noise level would be, because the Kitchenaid door was much heavier and I was right to be concerned. the motor is quiet but the water hitting the door is beyond obnoxious. I am thinking about taking the door off and disassembling it so I can find some audio sound deadening material to place on the inside panel. I scratch my head at how GE would run this and not think it was acceptable, especially after boasting about it's Ultra Quiet 47 decibel noise level. Sentence (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person I finally installed a dishwasher.
Comments (English): Media Dishwasher 6-person I finally installed a dishwasher. Since last year, I have had pain from my hips to my legs due to spinal stenosis, so it was difficult to wash dishes. The pain got worse when I was halfway through washing dishes, so it was difficult to finish them all, so I desperately needed a dishwasher, but I couldn't find a place to install one in my kitchen, so I couldn't order one. I thought I only needed to install a built-in dishwasher, but I only recently found out that there was a countertop dishwasher, so I ordered one. I was able to make space next to the water purifier, and installing the dishwasher significantly reduced the amount of dishwashing. The Media countertop dishwasher is installed on the sink, and the drain is discharged into the sink, so it is much easier to install than the built-in one. I also connected the water supply to the water purifier line, so the installation was completed in 10 minutes. I use the dishwasher twice a day, in the morning and evening, so it is convenient and good. The door doesn't open automatically, so after the dishwasher is finished, I have to open the door myself after 10 minutes, and there is no drying function, but it dries with residual heat, so the dishes are almost dry when I clean them in the morning. Compared to Samsung, I bought a media dishwasher that was much cheaper. I can change the settings to seven modes, and although it doesn't have many functions, it's easy to use, so I think I made a good purchase. I usually set it to P2 and run the dishwasher. It's a little frustrating because there's no window to see inside, but I think I made a good purchase.
Comments (Original): 미디어 식기세척기 6인용 드디어 식기 세척기를 설치 했어요. 작년부터 척추협착으로 엉덩이부터 다리 까지 통증이 있어서 설겆이를 할때 힘들었어요. 설겆이를 절반쯤 할때쯤이면 통증이 심해져 끝까지 마무리 하기가 힘들 정도여서 식기 세척기가 절실 했는데 우리 주방에 식기 세척기를 설치할 자리를 찾지 못해서 주문을 못 했어요.빌트인 식기세척기만 설치해야 되는줄 알았는데 얼마전에야 카운트 탑 식기 세척기가 있는줄 알고 주문했어요. 정수기 옆에 공간을 마련할수 있었고 식기 세척기를 설치하니 설겆이가 훨씬 줄어 드네요. 미디어 카운트 탑 식기 세척기를 싱크대 위에 설치하고 배수구는 개수대로 배출하니 빌트인에 비해 설치가 정말 간편하네요. 물 공급도 정수기 선에 연결하니 설치가 10분만에 완성이 되었어요. 아침 저녁으로 하루에 두번 식기 세척기를 사용하니 간편하고 좋아요. 문 자동 개폐가 아니여서 식기 세척기가 끝나고. 십분후 직접 문을 열어야 되고 건조기능이 없지만 잔열로 건조가 되어 아침에 그릇을 정리 할때는 거의 건조가 되어 있어요. 삼성과 비교하다 가격이 훨신 저렴한 미디어 식기 세척기로 구입 했는데  일곱가지 모드로 설정을 바꿀수 있고 기능이 많지 않아도 사용하기 좋아서 잘 구입했다는 생각이드네요. 저는 주로 P2로 설정하고 세척기를 돌리고 있어요. 내부를 볼수 있는 창이 없어서 조금 답답하지만 잘 샀다는 생각이 드네요.

Comments (English): [ I only trust my dishwasher aunt in the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || Hello? Today, I'm going to review LG's Objet Collection dishwasher. I've been using an LG 12-person dishwasher for about 5 years, and this time, I bought an Objet Collection 14-person dishwasher from Coupang as a moving gift for my new sister-in-law! These days, even home appliances can't keep up with Coupang. The price is the price, and Coupang's rocket delivery (you can change it on the date you want) is really the best! They said that the technician installed it on the date you wanted the day after you moved! There must be many people who are worried about dishwashers. The biggest concern is that it's faster to just wash the dishes, isn't it better to do it right away? It's cleaner to do it with your own hands! Isn't it noisy? Don't you worry about these things? After using it for about 5 years, it's the best kitchen item that I've ever lived without. I looked up a lot of brands when I bought it, and when I bought it, LG's was really quiet! I'm still using it to this day! The Objet Collection I gifted this time is really pretty, as expected from LG's premium line. It goes perfectly with my white kitchen! The advantages of the LG Objet Collection dishwasher in my opinion are. 1. It's pretty! These days, the functions are actually similar, so I think the design plays a part in the choice! An appliance that is definitely pretty! 2. True Steam function - As a parent, I want it to be washed so cleanly that there are no residual detergents or residual oil stains, and when I think about hygiene, LG's 100-degree True Steam function seems to be the best! I always include True Steam in every course! 3. Powerful tornado washing blade - The powerful tornado washing blade creates a three-dimensional water stream, so it can wash every nook and cranny without leaving any spot. When you actually put in a lot of dishes, you often put them in overlapping, right? But it can really wash all the overlapping dishes cleanly! 4. No need to worry about water stains with the water softener - This may vary depending on the detergent, but if you use a small amount of detergent, water stains don't appear! However, it doesn't seem to have poor cleaning power. (Since the dishwasher washes with high-temperature water, the cleaning effect is good enough!) 5. The triple drying method dries even the remaining moisture - When I touch the dishes that are still crisp in the morning after the dishwashing is complete, I feel like I made a good purchase! LG products dry dishes in three ways: 1. Condensation drying, 2. Automatic door opening drying, and 3. Hot air drying. 6. Smart shelf - Looking at the added functions, the top can be adjusted to three levels of height (sometimes the height is a bit lacking when putting in a pot, but this problem is solved right away) and there is a knife or scissors holder at the bottom that can be folded and unfolded? This is really useful! And the best thing about using a dishwasher is that it saves time! If there's too much food on it, you do have to rinse it out, but it really does cut down on dishwashing time! Sentence (English): This is a review of a product I bought with my own money.
Comments (English): [ This is the best item I bought in the first half of this year! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. I hate doing dishes the most out of all household chores. The Minix dishwasher is the best purchase I made in the first half of the year! Size: 2-3 meals for a single-person household. Cleaning power: After a light pre-wash, it'll be sparkling clean! Some might think, "I'd rather just do the dishes," but since I usually hate rinsing and drying dishes, just solving this problem is incredibly satisfying. Pro 1: Water Tank: This product can be connected directly to the water supply, but I currently fill the water tank with water. I fill the included cup and pour it in 3-4 times. The water tank is built into the bottom of the product, so it doesn't take up much space. It works well even in a small kitchen. Pro 2: Design and Detail: The modern design doesn't detract from the interior. The upper shelf is removable, and the wheels underneath make it easy to access the contents. Con 1: Water Stains: Even though it has a drying function, water stains do remain. People with sensitive skin might find it untidy. Disappointing point 2: It doesn't fit a frying pan. It's a small product, so it's natural, but it doesn't fit large frying pans. So, I agree with the TMI saying that the dishwasher is a great deal, but in a small kitchen, you can enjoy the convenience of a Minix product. Even when I run it after air frying and the dishes are greasy, I only do a light pre-wash beforehand, and it removes all the grease. My husband and I are 200% satisfied. It really improves our quality of life! Anyway, I highly recommend it. If this was helpful, I would appreciate it if you could click 'Helpful'.

Sentence (English): Honestly, I had a lot of concerns when I first bought the dishwasher.

Oily dishes, pots with burnt-on parts, etc.? No need to worry. ] || ---------------- || Honestly, I had a lot of concerns when I first bought the dishwasher. But to tell you the conclusion, I think I made a really good purchase. I'll start with the cleaning power. Oily dishes, slightly burnt pots? No need to worry. It uses hot water over 80 degrees and steam to thoroughly clean the dishes. I'm really impressed when I look at the glass cups. They just shine. I really like the drying function. When it's done, the door opens smoothly. The natural wind removes all the moisture, so even the plastic dishes are fluffy and dry. The dishwashers I used in the past were always lacking in drying, but I don't have to worry about that with this one. The storage space is also great. The shelves are divided into three levels, so you can adjust them to the size of the dishes. You can easily put in large pots and frying pans, and my family (a family of four) can clean all the dishes from the day at once. You don't have to stress about the dishes piling up. And the app connection is a secret sweet deal. It's secretly convenient because I can turn it on with my phone when I go out or change the washing course. It's fun to set the timer on a busy morning and go to work. The design goes without saying. The beige color unique to the Objet Collection goes well with the kitchen. It looks luxurious and the kitchen atmosphere has completely changed. It's built-in, so it doesn't take up space and is neat. In summary,. The price range is not cheap, but I think it's worth it for the quality. I'm really satisfied with it and I'm recommending it to my friends. I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to get rid of the stress of washing dishes.

Sentence (English): I replaced a 10 year old Bosch with the a 300 series model.
Comments (English): [ This is a great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I replaced a 10 year old Bosch with the a 300 series model. I did the install myself and it went quite well. My only problem was that the power cord was about two feet too short to reach the outlet. Rather than add a way too long extension cord to complete the connection, which it what was used for the old dishwasher, I used a power strip with a 3 ft cord and mounted it to the back of the cabinet 2 feet toward the new dishwater. Bosch doesn't offer a longer cord and the connector on the dishwasher end is of a special design that prevented me from buying a longer cord on my own. Except for that relatively minor complication, everything went together without a hitch. The dishwasher is works great. The upper "3rd rack" holds more silverware than I've got in the house and really opened up space on the lower rack for more dishes, bowls, etc. The silverware has been coming out really clean, consistently. My old Bosch didn't do as well with silverware loaded into the baskets on the right hand side of the first rack. All the dishes have been coming out really clean. No need for any spot cleaning! The feature we really like about the 300 is how quiet it is. The dishwasher is pretty close to the family room, but it runs so quietly, it doesn' t interfere with our TV watching or conversations. The washer appears to be very well built. The stainless steel interior should last a long time. I like the touch controls on the front of washer. We selected this design over model that place the controls on the top edge of the drawer. This is also a "smart" appliance. So far, I haven't done anything with the app, other than to load it onto my phone. The app notifies when the wash cycle is complete. Not sure what else it does.

Sentence (English): I used a built-in dishwasher before moving in, but I didn't want to take it with me.
Comments (English): [ Essential appliances even without a husband! ] || ---------------- || I used a built-in dishwasher before moving in, but I didn't want to take it with me. I just asked the new tenant, and since they said they would use it, I left it behind. After moving in and having the sink installed, it turned out to be narrower than I expected. So, I gave up on the built-in model and decided to just do the dishes manually. However, that didn't work out. Although we are a family of five, we only eat out on weekends and typically have one dinner on weekdays, so we didn't generate a huge amount of dishes for a family of five. That's why I kept searching online and discovered the Samsung Bespoke Countertop. Fortunately, I had enough space, so I just went ahead and bought it. First off, the design is clean and luxurious, which really livens up the kitchen atmosphere. It isn't too big, so it's perfect for a small kitchen. The cleaning power is better than expected; even greasy dishes come out squeaky clean (I actually touched them after the wash was finished). I had seen reviews mentioning water pooling, but unless there is standing water, as long as you don't use the automatic door opening function to remove the dishes immediately, they dry up nicely before you know it. Since some of my dishes had a slight dent, I just shook out the water that had pooled and put them back in their place. It feels so refreshing. It is also quite quiet, so I don't feel burdened running it at night. However, the space is a bit awkward for pots or large frying pans, so there are times when I have to wash them by hand. Still, that is perfectly manageable. Since my dishwashing stress has decreased, my day feels much more relaxed. The kitchen is tidy, and because I save time, I feel like I’ve become more diligent for no reason. I can confidently recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher! My husband used to only do the dishes on weekends, but now he runs the dishwasher after dinner. Perhaps because of the hot water coming out when I run it once or twice a day, I find myself cleaning the drain less often.

Sentence (English): Five stars for the dishwasher & 4 stars on the Home Connect App.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher But App Should Be Enhanced ] || ---------------- || Five stars for the dishwasher & 4 stars on the Home Connect App. The dishwasher has so many good things about it! The 3rd rack for the miscellaneous larger spoons, spatulas, and other small flat items. Also the adjustable 2nd rack has been really handy to allow various bowls (ones that are not to be placed on the bottom shelf) and cups etc on this 2nd shelf. The 3rd shelf is set up perfectly for our silverware rack, plates, and other larger items. The three rack design is absolutely awesome! The dishes don't always dry completely but this may have something to do with the specific options we selected for our favorites app. Either way, it's not extremely wet & we just sit the couple things on a towel that require extra drying time. One suggestion: Adding a towel rack handle to it, which would help with opening and closing the door and also provide a place to hang towels. Since the surface of the door is metal (not aluminum), we were attached a magnetized towel bar to it (which works pretty good other than if we mistakenly pull on it). Also the jet dry compartment is very difficult to determine when it's filled up as there's no window so the only way to tell it's full is when it overflows. Suggest an enhancement to this as well! The primary issue we've encountered is with the Home Connect App. It didn't display our favorite wash cycle on top of the screen. Instead it displayed a random auto/normal cycle. We wanted the favorite wash cycle at the top of the main screen. In which I accidentally figured it out. This shouldn't have been so difficult to figure out! We have our favorites set specifically how we want it and it uses 2.3 gallons of water for the wash cycle vs 3.0 to 4.4 gallons. We previously had to scroll down to select our favorite option. It's much better now that our favorite cycle is at the top! Lastly, the wash cycle appears to be quite long (about 2 hours & 20 to 30 minutes) and I believe the shortest time is like 2 hours. Even a half load option estimates the time as 2 hours and 2 minutes with 3 gallons of water; whereas unchecking half load it says 2 hours and 20 minutes with 2.3 gallons of water (and the time and water usage changes as different options are selected (e.g. sanitize, extra dry). I think the App should be more user friendly and the dishwasher settings include some efficient options, especially for smaller loads. One plus is the App allows the dishwasher to be set up and started from it as long as the door is closed. It took us a bit to figure out how to navigate within the App! I just recently noticed they do have a few how to tutorials regarding the dishwasher upon gaining access to the App & scrolling towards the bottom of the main page of this App. The App doesn't always notify me upon completion. Perhaps Bosch could place a brochure on the dishwasher to point the buyers to their tutorials. That might help make it easier to figure out how to work the App and operate the dishwasher. It just took us so long to figure out how to navigate within the App!

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for a little over two months and it has been great!
Comments (English): [ Solid Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for a little over two months and it has been great! I would like to preface that this review is based on using the recommended Finish dishwasher pods, I am not sure how the dishwasher will perform using other dishwasher pods. All my dishes have come out clean, even those on the top rack. The middle and bottom racks have one adjustable row. I was excited about this feature before buying it but it wasn't what I was expecting, and I'm indifferent about them. I like the deeper bottom rack, and the nylon coating on racks looks great. Noise level wise, the dishwasher is pretty quiet but expect a little noise, not enough to bother but enough for you to know it's on. The only issue I've had so far is that the cycle memory hasn't kicked in for me. I was told after I used the same cycle a few times, that setting would automatically come up the next time I turned on the dishwasher. Sadly, that hasn't happened for me yet. Overall, I feel like this is a solid dishwasher. It looks and feels well-built and will hopefully last me several years. I would highly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): Exceptionally quiet and performs well.
Comments (English): [ Nice appliance ] || ---------------- || Exceptionally quiet and performs well. It's almost silent sometimes. Yay! But, DIY installation was a challenge at the least and the racking could be more imaginative. Read the manual before buying and although we had sufficient clearance I had to remove all four feet and cut the insulation blanket to get it to fit under the counter. I was unable to use the existing copper water line. After trimming the length it fit perfectly, but there was no room to turn a wrench to tighten the compression fitting so had to resort to a flexible line that will need to be replaced in 5 years. Electrical was tight, too, having to struggle with terminal box connections rather than wire nuts. And no room underneath the pump motor to slide the excess Romex wire out of the way so had to find room to fold it up. Our old Whirlpool was also a tall tub, but was much easier to work on. Still experimenting with how best to load it. Not a lot of versatility with the racks as compared to past machines. Maybe we should have looked around a bit more, but I have always tended to be loyal to Whirlpool and its associated brands.

I was also a bit uneasy about the brand of this product. However, my worries were unfounded. Even though there are only two of us and we eat three meals a day, I only run it once in the evening. Since I can hand-wash pots and pans or leftover dishes, it saves me a lot of time, which is great, and the dishes get cleaned really well. Even my married daughter, who strongly recommended the 12-place setting model, is happy to see that I'm satisfied. No worries about a locked dishwasher in case of a power outage.The dishwasher contains the same StormWash+ feature on previous models for cleaning pots and pans, which is nice to have. The top rack has a new dedicated glass cleaning bay that focuses water streams on your glassware. This seems like a nice dedicated function which should help to clean glass better vs. being placed vertically on the bottom rack. You lose a little space for silverware in the top rack compared to the old dishwasher, but we have found ourselves not using the full utensil rack on the old machine and therefore space utilization is more optimal with this new feature.Racks adjust vertically easily and glide flawlessly when opening and closing. They layout (which is adjustable) works better than with our old dishwasher and provides numerous fixtures to support pans, wine glasses and other large dishes as needed.Integration with SmartThings has been done well. My Galaxy Fold 5 immediately and automatically discovered the dishwasher once it was plugged in. Setup was a breeze and I had it working remotely in no time without any difficulties. Enabling certain features like Smart Heat Dry are only accessible if the remote function is enabled at the dishwasher. It would be nice if this wasn't required and was always automatically enabled. This is an impressive machine and we are pleased with our purchase.

I have a 1 liter SodaStream bottle, and it does not fit in either positions. I also have a 32 oz insulated drinking cup, and it does not fit the upper position. For this to fit properly, I have to remove the 3rd rack. This was the one of the main reason I bought this unit. If I lower the upper rack, and I have a frying pan on the bottom rack, the upper rotating water spray is obstructed. Switching position of the upper rack can be annoying. You have to remove the entire rack, and carefully line up the wheels and the rails to the preferred position (upper or lower). What is missing also is an attachment to hold the stems of wine glasses. Due to height restrictions caused by the 3rd rack most stemware (wine glasses, martini glasses, and champagne flutes) does not fit. So, I guess hand washing these items is the only option.The bottom rack is a no frills rack. There is no adjustment to accommodate awkward items. The silverware holder is small. I selected Normal wash, with Sanitizing Steam, Bottle washer enabled, Dry Boost Max and the cycle almost took 5 HOURS! Normal wash only is 1.5 hours.Normal wash with Dry Boost Max is 3 Hours (no bottle wash, no sanitizing steam).Installation was easy. The tedious part is leveling the dishwasher so it is level horizontally and vertically. The best approach is to level the back feet first. This will level the washing machine horizontally across. This is the part when you have to be aware and adjust the height accordingly. Too low, there will be a gap underneath your counter. So, be advised to always mind the gap when adjusting the rear feet. One direction will raise it, the other will lower it. Once that is done, you carefully push it back in place, then adjust the front feet. Adjusting the front feet will adjust the leveling vertically. So use a level and place vertically on the front panel (face). It may either lean forward, if so then raise it. If it is leaning back, then lower the front feet until level.So, after testing the wash, it has some noise. Not enough to keep you awake, but you can hear it. After using the dry boost in Max settings, the dishes were dry. It was not a full load because I was testing it. However, the dishwasher doors, racks, and interior housing was WET! The control panel, I noticed there was a millimeter gap. I don't know if this was a design that way, or a manufacture defect. I decided to superglue it at certain spots to ensure there is no water going inside the electrical components inside. For this, it could have been 5 stars but the features is not that convenient when you can use all the features all at once. With large items in lower rack, you have to raise the upper rack; however, you can't wash bottles or 32oz cups when the upper rack is in the upper position. Basically the features require compromise. You have to give up one for the other. So I gave this unit 3 stars.

SodaStream Bottles). ] || ---------------- || The bottle washer is great provided the bottle fits the bottle on either position 1 or position 2. I have a 1 liter SodaStream bottle, and it does not fit in either positions. I also have a 32 oz insulated drinking cup, and it does not fit the upper position. For this to fit properly, I have to remove the 3rd rack. This was the one of the main reason I bought this unit. If I lower the upper rack, and I have a frying pan on the bottom rack, the upper rotating water spray is obstructed. Switching position of the upper rack can be annoying. You have to remove the entire rack, and carefully line up the wheels and the rails to the preferred position (upper or lower). What is missing also is an attachment to hold the stems of wine glasses. Due to height restrictions caused by the 3rd rack most stemware (wine glasses, martini glasses, and champagne flutes) does not fit. So, I guess hand washing these items is the only option.The bottom rack is a no frills rack. There is no adjustment to accommodate awkward items. The silverware holder is small. I selected Normal wash, with Sanitizing Steam, Bottle washer enabled, Dry Boost Max and the cycle almost took 5 HOURS! Normal wash only is 1.5 hours.Normal wash with Dry Boost Max is 3 Hours (no bottle wash, no sanitizing steam).Installation was easy. The tedious part is leveling the dishwasher so it is level horizontally and vertically. The best approach is to level the back feet first. This will level the washing machine horizontally across. This is the part when you have to be aware and adjust the height accordingly. Too low, there will be a gap underneath your counter. So, be advised to always mind the gap when adjusting the rear feet. One direction will raise it, the other will lower it. Once that is done, you carefully push it back in place, then adjust the front feet. Adjusting the front feet will adjust the leveling vertically. So use a level and place vertically on the front panel (face). It may either lean forward, if so then raise it. If it is leaning back, then lower the front feet until level.So, after testing the wash, it has some noise. Not enough to keep you awake, but you can hear it. After using the dry boost in Max settings, the dishes were dry. It was not a full load because I was testing it. However, the dishwasher doors, racks, and interior housing was WET! The control panel, I noticed there was a millimeter gap. I don't know if this was a design that way, or a manufacture defect. I decided to superglue it at certain spots to ensure there is no water going inside the electrical components inside. For this, it could have been 5 stars but the features is not that convenient when you can use all the features all at once. With large items in lower rack, you have to raise the upper rack; however, you can't wash bottles or 32oz cups when the upper rack is in the upper position. Basically the features require compromise. You have to give up one for the other. So I gave this unit 3 stars.

Sentence (English): I will start with start with the positives.
Comments (English): [ It's fine. ] || ---------------- || I will start with start with the positives. This dishwasher is the quietest dishwasher I've ever had. It is so quiet that sometimes we wonder if it's even in running. For that reason, there is a subtle red LED light indicator that shines on the floor to let you know that it is running. Secondly, it has a top tray 3rd tray for utensils, which is nice because the bottom tray is used exclusively for larger items, without sacrificing a portion of the tray for the typical utensil caddy. Third, which is a pro for most but with a caveat. It is incredibly efficient in terms of water usagex which is fabulous. The caveat is that it's so efficient that it wasn't pulling enough water to kick our tankless hot water heater on. So hot water wasn't being supplied to the dishwasher. We ended up having to install a small 3 gallon hot water heater under the kitchen sink to mitigate this. Now here are a few a things that are slightly annoying. First, the feedback when you press the buttons is lacking. And by lacking, I mean there isn't any. Secondly, there is a weird delay when you press the power button to turn the dishwasher on. Regarding the status light that shines on the floor, it's great to know that the dishwasher is running. However, it's only red. The light never changes color to let you know what part of the cycle the dishwasher is in. There is no time indicator or anything. So when dishwasher is running there's absolutely no way to tell how much longer it's going to run for. You either know it's running because the red lights on or it's off. There's nothing in between. Honestly, this dishwasher is just OK. It definitely does what it's supposed to do… Wash dishes.

Sentence (English): Just put the dishes in and press the button. (
Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

(시간 오래 걸림.) • 플라스틱 용기는 뜨거운 물 때문에 약간 변형될 수 있으니 조심.4. 소음 • 생각보다 조용하다. 밤에 돌려도 옆집 신경 안 쓰임. (내가 옆에서 TV 봐도 괜찮은 수준.)5. 아쉬운 점 • 큰 냄비, 웍? 포기해라. 따로 손설거지해야 함. • 진짜 풀로 꽉꽉 채우면 세척이 좀 덜 되는 느낌 있음. (6인용이라 한계 있음.)6. 결론 • “설거지 하기 싫은 워킹맘/1~2인 가구”는 무조건 사라. • 하루 한 번 돌리면 스트레스 지수 70% 감소. • 대신 주방이 좁으면 답답해 보일수 있음**가장 중요한 전기세35000원/년1회표준/100원강력세척은 10원20원정도 더 나올듯하다고 하심온수가 나와서 세척기에 들어가는것이 아니고 냉수가 급수되어서 세척기에가 뜨겁게 하여 세척해준다고 함

Sentence (English): You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power.
Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Sentence (English): Big pots, woks?
Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Sentence (English): If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%.
Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Comments (English): [ I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation It was bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before. ] || ---------------- || I ordered 12 people, but when I saw that the remodeled sink needed to be rebuilt, I returned it and bought this again. 1. Appearance/Installation. It's bigger than I thought. The technician called the day before and set a time. It took about 10 minutes to install. And he explained it in detail. Once it's in place, the design is clean and gives the kitchen a more luxurious look. 2. Feel. When the dishes pile up, it's a whole new world. Just put the dishes in and press the button. (No mental breakdown while washing dishes.). However, you need to know how to arrange the dishes. If you just put them in, they won't all be washed. You need to arrange them with some space for better cleaning power. 3. Cleaning power. Rice and soup-stained dishes? They'll all disappear. However, seasoning and burnt food sometimes remain. In that case, turn on the 'strong mode' to solve the problem. (It takes a long time.). Be careful because the plastic container can be slightly deformed by the hot water. 4. Noise. It's quieter than I thought. Even if I turn it on at night, my neighbors won't be bothered. (It's okay even when I'm watching TV next to me.). 5. Disappointing points. Big pots, woks? Give up. You have to wash them separately. If you really fill it up with starch, it feels like it's not that easy to clean. (It's for 6 people, so there's a limit.) 6. Conclusion. Working moms/1-2 person households who hate washing dishes should definitely buy it. If you run it once a day, your stress level will decrease by 70%. However, if your kitchen is small, it might look stuffy. **The most important thing is the electricity bill. 35,000 won/year. Standard per use/100 won. They say that a strong wash would cost about 10-20 won more. It doesn't say that hot water comes out and goes into the dishwasher, but that cold water is supplied and the dishwasher heats it up and washes it.

Sentence (English): I seriously debated whether to buy a dishwasher when moving.
Comments (English): [ Why did I only buy it now ~~ ] || ---------------- || I seriously debated whether to buy a dishwasher when moving. Since we're all about getting the dishes done right away, I wondered if it was really necessary. I was really worried until the very end, but the price difference between buying a dishwasher cabinet and buying a dishwasher itself wasn't that big, so I ended up buying one. The sleek design really caught my eye. The installer was very thorough, explained everything in detail, and was incredibly friendly, which instantly boosted my favorability rating. A few days later, I tried it for the first time, and I was worried it might be too noisy. It was surprisingly quieter than I expected, and it didn't take too long. Sentence (English): The bottle washer is great provided the bottle fits the bottle on either position 1 or position 2.
Comments (English): [ Almost perfect, some items may or may not fit. (ie. SodaStream Bottles). ] || ---------------- || The bottle washer is great provided the bottle fits the bottle on either position 1 or position 2. I have a 1 liter SodaStream bottle, and it does not fit in either positions. I also have a 32 oz insulated drinking cup, and it does not fit the upper position. For this to fit properly, I have to remove the 3rd rack. This was the one of the main reason I bought this unit. If I lower the upper rack, and I have a frying pan on the bottom rack, the upper rotating water spray is obstructed. Switching position of the upper rack can be annoying. You have to remove the entire rack, and carefully line up the wheels and the rails to the preferred position (upper or lower). What is missing also is an attachment to hold the stems of wine glasses. Due to height restrictions caused by the 3rd rack most stemware (wine glasses, martini glasses, and champagne flutes) does not fit. So, I guess hand washing these items is the only option. The bottom rack is a no frills rack. There is no adjustment to accommodate awkward items. The silverware holder is small. I selected Normal wash, with Sanitizing Steam, Bottle washer enabled, Dry Boost Max and the cycle almost took 5 HOURS! Normal wash only is 1.5 hours. Normal wash with Dry Boost Max is 3 Hours (no bottle wash, no sanitizing steam). Installation was easy. The tedious part is leveling the dishwasher so it is level horizontally and vertically. The best approach is to level the back feet first. This will level the washing machine horizontally across. This is the part when you have to be aware and adjust the height accordingly. Too low, there will be a gap underneath your counter. So, be advised to always mind the gap when adjusting the rear feet. One direction will raise it, the other will lower it. Once that is done, you carefully push it back in place, then adjust the front feet. Adjusting the front feet will adjust the leveling vertically. So use a level and place vertically on the front panel (face). It may either lean forward, if so then raise it. If it is leaning back, then lower the front feet until level. So, after testing the wash, it has some noise. Not enough to keep you awake, but you can hear it. After using the dry boost in Max settings, the dishes were dry. It was not a full load because I was testing it. However, the dishwasher doors, racks, and interior housing was WET! The control panel, I noticed there was a millimeter gap. I don't know if this was a design that way, or a manufacture defect. I decided to superglue it at certain spots to ensure there is no water going inside the electrical components inside. For this, it could have been 5 stars but the features is not that convenient when you can use all the features all at once. With large items in lower rack, you have to raise the upper rack; however, you can't wash bottles or 32oz cups when the upper rack is in the upper position. Basically the features require compromise. You have to give up one for the other. So I gave this unit 3 stars.

You lose a little space for silverware in the top rack compared to the old dishwasher, but we have found ourselves not using the full utensil rack on the old machine and therefore space utilization is more optimal with this new feature. Racks adjust vertically easily and glide flawlessly when opening and closing. They layout (which is adjustable) works better than with our old dishwasher and provides numerous fixtures to support pans, wine glasses and other large dishes as needed. Integration with SmartThings has been done well. My Galaxy Fold 5 immediately and automatically discovered the dishwasher once it was plugged in. Setup was a breeze and I had it working remotely in no time without any difficulties. Enabling certain features like Smart Heat Dry are only accessible if the remote function is enabled at the dishwasher. It would be nice if this wasn't required and was always automatically enabled. This is an impressive machine and we are pleased with our purchase.

Overall so far, just an ok dishwasher with too much nonsensical technology and not enough essential features.

Sentence (English): We owned a Kitchen Aid dishwasher for more than 20 years with no problems and was used very frequently with family.
Comments (English): [ New Bosch dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We owned a Kitchen Aid dishwasher for more than 20 years with no problems and was used very frequently with family. We decided on Bosch this time because of good reviews and the best service record. We like the units look and how quiet it runs, almost can't hear it. We also liked the third silverware rack. The installation went well and the provided video instructions were helpful. These were first impressions compared to our Kitchen Aid dish washer. A couple of items that we were not as good as kitchen aid was the light weight racks that do not seem to roll as well with smaller rollers. The Bosch unit seems to wash the dishes good. All in all, a very good product.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher two years ago and it broke down for the first time almost a month ago.
Comments (English): [ Warranty issues - Unacceptable ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher two years ago and it broke down for the first time almost a month ago. We purchased the Home Depot warranty for this product at the time of purchase. We called the warranty and filed a claim and they scheduled a technician to come out. The technician rescheduled twice before he ever came out. When he finally did come, they had pre-ordered the wrong part, and we were informed that he would have to contact Home Depot have the new part ordered and he would come back when the part was received. A week later we get a notification that our technician is scheduled to come out that week. He rescheduled for a day later than he was supposed to come out and then when he arrives the following day, he informs me that we should have received the new part and since we didn't, he has to leave and can't do anything and that we would have to call the Home Depot warranty department. I called the Home Depot warranty department and speak with a woman who says she has no idea why we didn't receive the part because it was shipped overnighted to us and should have arrived the day before. Keep in mind that the technician was supposed to come out the day before, and the part should've been ordered the week prior so even though it was supposed to be overnighted, they ordered the part late. She says that she's going to file a new claim for the part and that we will get a notification when things are rescheduled. The part arrives the next day and the technician is scheduled to come out between 430 and 7:30 PM. I called and spoke with the receptionist for the technician to confirm that we were scheduled for that evening. I had already spoken with the Home Depot warranty department the day before and explained what had been going on so things should have been fine. 8 PM rolls around and the technician never arrived so I call his secretary who tells me that our claim has been canceled by Home Depot and that we need to call them. I call them and they tell me that Because the technician came out so many times and couldn't fix the problem that they deemed it unfixable and canceled our claim. Seeing as I had spoken with a representative from Home Depot the day before, and this was their technician that they scheduled and should have been communicating with, I have no idea how they didn't know That he had actually only come twice and both times didn't have the part which is why the problem wasn't solved. The representative from Home Depot proceeds to tell me that my options are they will reimburse us for the dishwasher to go buy a new one in which case we would need to pay out-of-pocket for a new warranty as well as the actual installation or we could have our own technician come out fix the problem and submit the invoice for reimbursement, but if the repairs cost more than the price of the dishwasher, we have to pay out-of-pocket. We had our own technician come out today who fixed the problem in less than 10 minutes and had the part he needed already in his truck and showed up early for our appointment. Needless to say, we will no longer be shopping at Home Depot, and I cannot recommend their warranty to anyone. Absolutely unacceptable. Waited three weeks to get our dishwasher fixed through their own warranty only to have to call our own technician and get it fixed during the first appointment.

App is functional and setup was relatively straightforward. Layout/design: Both cutlery trays could do with design improvements, a tad flimsy and not the easiest to stack. The cutlery basket compartments (without divider on top) are too wide and cultery tends to fall to one direction, and with the divider on top things like children's cutlery and thicker or wider ended cutlery doesn't fit in the holes meaning neither scenario is ideal. Cultery draw is okay, but layout means large utensils like tongs etc don't fit up here. Top draw layout is awesome. Bottom needs improvement. The wider spaced plate holders should be throughout the bottom, the narrow don't fit any of our plates let alone bowls and really are completely impractical. Not sure what people fit between those but what could have maximised capacity ends up limiting the bottom drawer entirely. Had it a week, but other than layout it's working as expected.

Sentence (English): Tips for using your own dishwasher 1.
Comments (English): Tips for using your own dishwasher 1. Just shake off the remaining food and put it in! It has powerful cleaning power without rinsing, so it's good for saving time and water. (Especially the most efficient for those who are raising children) 2. Distribute the dishes by positioning them. Place glass cups/thin dishes in the upper compartment and pots/frying pans in the lower compartment for more thorough cleaning. 3. Regular filter cleaning is essential! Simply clean the filter once every two weeks to use it comfortably without any unpleasant odors. 4. Use detergent specifically for dishwashers! Regular detergents have a lot of bubbles and can cause malfunctions. Using a dedicated detergent increases cleaning power and extends the life of the device! 5. Schedule cleaning before going to work in the morning. If you schedule washing in the morning, the dishes that pile up overnight will be clean and squeaky clean when you get home! Sentence (English): I was using a 6-person countertop dishwasher, but the sink was narrow and the capacity was small, so I upgraded to a 14-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I'm using it conveniently. ] || ---------------- || I was using a 6-person countertop dishwasher, but the sink was narrow and the capacity was small, so I upgraded to a 14-person dishwasher. I previously used a 6-person one because I didn't have to empty a cabinet and I liked that I could use it without bending down. Fortunately, the space under the long cabinet was just right for the dishwasher, so I installed it without any major construction. They told me it needed reinforcement work, so I installed six pieces at the top and paid an additional 50,000 won. After using it, I found that it was great for holding pots, frying pans, and other large cooking utensils at once, and I didn't have to bend over too much. I had an error message because I put in too much detergent, but after reducing the amount of detergent, it's been working fine. Seeing the dishes clean makes me happy.

Comments (English): [ Loving My New Samsung Dishwasher: Sleek, Smart, an ] || ---------------- || I've been a loyal Samsung customer for years, and their products almost always deliver a great experience. I recently upgraded my 2020 Samsung dishwasher to the new DW90F89T0U12AA in White Glass, mainly because I wanted to switch to a white finish to match my kitchen. My old dishwasher worked well overall, but every now and then I'd get an error about water being stuck, which meant waiting for it to evaporate before running it again. Other than that, it never really gave me any trouble.The delivery for this new dishwasher was quick, and the installation team was friendly and professional. The only hiccup was that the third rack was damaged during shipping, so I had to contact Samsung support for a replacement part. Fortunately, their support team handled it pretty smoothly.Now that I've been using this new dishwasher for a while, I can really tell the difference. It's noticeably quieter than my previous model. At 38dBA, I can actually run it overnight and nobody in the house even notices. The dishwasher automatically senses how dirty the dishes are and adjusts the cycle, which I've noticed has helped save energy and water. The Smart Dry and Auto Release feature work really well too. The dishes come out dry, and the door pops open just enough at the end of the cycle to help with airflow. Drying is definitely faster than my old machine.One of my favorite updates is the new interior light. It sounds like a small thing, but it's super handy when loading or unloading dishes at night. I guess lights inside appliances are becoming the norm, but it really does make a difference.As for the design, the White Glass finish looks fantastic. It's modern, sleek, and adds a bit of elegance to my kitchen compared to standard stainless steel. The 3rd Rack Washing System is also a game-changer. It optimizes the space really well, so I can fit more utensils and smaller items without crowding the main racks.Overall, I'm really happy with this upgrade. Samsung continues to impress me with thoughtful features and a stylish design. I would definitely recommend it.

Sentence (English): This is quite possibly the worst dishwasher I have ever used.
Comments (English): [ Terrible Cleaning & Drying, Nice Interface ] || ---------------- || This is quite possibly the worst dishwasher I have ever used. It doesn't clean or dry well at all. Dishes come out clean (went in clean) and dry. The shelves are exceptionally wobbly, all of them but especially the top two. The top large shelf (not silverware tray) frequently won't slide in all of the way and gets jammed. The tongs on the shelves are very far apart, although flexible and they fold down, they are spread out so far you cannot pack too many dishes in, which is maybe a good thing because it doesn't clean well anyways. It isn't very quiet although I didn't purchase this one based on noise level. The only positive features are the top button panel and the LED screen hidden on the front face. The phone app is pretty good, works well and is easy to use. The only reason it received two stars is I like these features.

I can spend more time with my kids because I saved time. I'm so satisfied and happy. I think I made a great purchase as a dishwasher! If you're hesitating to buy, I highly recommend this product. Overall review: Would repurchase O I am very satisfied. There are so many advantages. There are many articles that say the cleaning power is disappointing, but I didn't feel any disappointing cleaning because I just put the dishes in after eating or simply rinsed them. Even if you just put in a plate with a lot of pork belly fat, it was cleaned very well. First of all, in terms of price, it seems to have similar performance to the SamX Bespoke at this reasonable price. I studied dishwashers whenever I had time during the month I was thinking about whether to buy it or not. There was a version with a window for 6 people in the same Media product, but it was tens of thousands of won more expensive, so I chose this product, but it's okay even without a window~~ I thought it would be good to have a window, so I was really worried, but when I actually used it, I didn't even care if it didn't exist~! There are many brand companies that import and sell products made by Media! SamX, KuX, etc. are all Media manufacturers. Of course, the finish is slightly different for each company, so the performance and functions may be slightly different, but I'm satisfied with the dishwashing itself. It has a two-tier basket. I use it without the upper basket when I put a cutting board or large dishes. The thing I was most curious about about this product was whether the ceiling inside was made of plastic or stainless steel, but it was stainless steel, so I think I made a good purchase. Most products from other brands have plastic ceilings. After running the dishwasher, the water doesn't completely dry. However, the door opens automatically, so after a few minutes, it's almost dry and most of it is removed. If you place the dishes at an angle, the water won't collect on top of the dishes and they'll dry better. I have a bad back, so I had to bend over to move the dishes with a 12-person built-in dishwasher. I don't think I'd use it even if I had one. This product is for 6 people, so I put it on top and use it without straining my back at all. Since it's next to the water purifier, they connected it to the water purifier hose without drilling. There is some noise, but it's not as loud as a ventilation fan. When the ventilation fan is on, I can't hear the dishwasher at all. It seems to be about half the noise of a ventilation fan. I don't run it after 10 p.m. because I'm afraid it might cause damage to other houses. I feel more secure because Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty. They say that after 2 years, it will be repaired for a fee. I also like that it's slim. It's perfect for a family of four. I used to have to leave it on the sink for 30 minutes to wash the dishes, but now I just rinse it with water after eating and put it back in to do the dishes. I can spend more time with my kids because I saved time. I'm so satisfied and happy. I think I made a great purchase as a dishwasher! If you're hesitating to buy, I highly recommend this product.
